ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In this diagram, man is a ________.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a food web, and the top center is labeled with the red “Man”. There are multiple arrows pointing from other animals to Man, including Arctic Wolves, Polar Bears, Kittiwakes, and Snowy Owls. Man is located at the very top of the food web. Reasoning: In this kind of food web, arrows usually go from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it, that is, pointing to the consumer or predator. Because Man receives arrows from multiple animals and is at the top of the food web, Man represents a predator in the image.
